firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently called their mother is the first question reader.
clarifications: That player draws and reads the first Question card. After voting and scoring, the player to their left draws and reads the next question.

uncertainty: The rules specify no tie procedure for calls made together.
The criterion chooses the first reader; voting itself is simultaneous.
